stories.title: Cadu de Lula grava programas para o segundo turno e promete ampliar diálogo com eleitor

en.title: Cadu de Lula records programs for second round and promises expanded voter dialogue
en.summary: Cadu de Lula, the PT's candidate for governor of Rio Grande do Norte, recorded electoral programs for the second round at an audiovisual production company in Natal. The material will air on television and radio stations starting Friday.

stories.title: Polícia de SP investiga corpos amarrados em sacos e tecidos e descarta ligação entre casos

en.title: São Paulo police investigate bodies tied in bags and fabrics and rule out connection between cases
en.summary: São Paulo's Civil Police is investigating eight deaths involving bodies found wrapped in plastic bags, comforters, and sheets since September. Investigators have determined the cases are unrelated to one another.

stories.title: Lula muda tom nas redes e grava vídeo em formato selfie após 1º turno

en.title: Lula changes tone on social media and records selfie-format video after first round
en.summary: President Lula posted a selfie-format video urging supporters to take to the streets following the election's first round. The recording signals a shift in the PT campaign's digital communication after Lula finished behind Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: STF exclui crédito de ICMS da base de cálculo de impostos federais e União estima impacto de R$16,5 bilhões

en.title: Supreme Court excludes ICMS credit from federal tax calculation basis; Union estimates R$16.5 billion impact
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court ruled that state tax incentives granted through ICMS should not be included in the calculation base for federal contributions PIS and Cofins. The government estimates the fiscal impact at R$16.5 billion.

stories.title: Traslado dos Carros abre romarias do Círio 2026 nesta quarta-feira; veja percurso

en.title: Traslado dos Carros opens Círio 2026 pilgrimages this Wednesday; see route
en.summary: The Traslado dos Carros, the first official pilgrimage of Círio 2026, will take place Wednesday in Belém, beginning at 6 p.m. from Praça Santuário with departure at 8 p.m., expected to attract approximately 30,000 devotees on a 5.5-kilometer route.

stories.title: TRE-MG pede à Meta e ao X dados sobre publicação de Nikolas Ferreira que mostrava documento falso

en.title: TRE-MG requests data from Meta and X regarding Nikolas Ferreira post showing false document
en.summary: An electoral court in Minas Gerais requested data from Meta and X regarding a post by politician Nikolas Ferreira that contained a forged document falsely attributed to the Federal Police.

stories.title: Sobrevivente de execução fracassada nos EUA seria desligada de suporte à vida antes de acordar

en.title: Survivor of failed execution in US would have been removed from life support before awakening
en.summary: A person who survived a failed execution in the United States would have been disconnected from life support before regaining consciousness.

stories.title: STF exclui créditos presumidos de ICMS da base do PIS e da Cofins

en.title: Supreme Court excludes ICMS presumed credits from PIS and Cofins calculation base
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court ruled that presumed ICMS credits granted by states cannot be included in the calculation base for federal taxes PIS and Cofins.

stories.title: Homem é preso em Praia Grande após agredir ex-mulher e sequestrar filha, segundo a polícia

en.title: Man arrested in Praia Grande after assaulting ex-partner and kidnapping daughter, police say
en.summary: A 37-year-old man was arrested in Praia Grande for allegedly kidnapping his ten-year-old daughter in Barueri and assaulting the child's mother.

stories.title: Polícia investiga mortes em série em SP, mas descarta ação de ‘serial killer’

en.title: Police investigate serial deaths in São Paulo but rule out serial killer
en.summary: Police are investigating multiple deaths in São Paulo but have determined they are not connected to a serial killer.

stories.title: Simulado do novo formato da Fuvest termina nesta quinta-feira (8); veja como fazer

en.title: Fuvest new format simulation ends Thursday (8); see how to participate
en.summary: A free simulation of the first phase of Fuvest's new test format ends Thursday, allowing students to practice the revised exam format being used this year.

stories.title: Quando é o debate da Globo entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro? Veja data

en.title: When is Globo's debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro? See date
en.summary: TV Globo will broadcast the final presidential debate on October 23, 2026, between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, moderated by anchor César Tralli. The network will also conduct separate interviews with both candidates on different dates determined by lottery.

stories.title: Industrialização da construção esbarra na capacidade de pagamento do comprador, aponta CEO

en.title: Industrialization of construction runs into buyer's payment capacity, CEO points out
en.summary: An industrialized construction approach increases production efficiency and speeds up projects, but buyers may lack the financial capacity to match this accelerated timeline, according to the CEO of developer ADN. Faster construction reduces the number of installment periods for property down payments, requiring greater buyer purchasing power.

stories.title: Americanas conclui venda de mais uma loja do Natural da Terra à rede Oba

en.title: Americanas completes sale of another Natural da Terra store to Oba chain
en.summary: Americanas completed the sale of its fifth Natural da Terra store to Oba Hortifruti as part of a ten-store transaction valued at 69.3 million reais. Oba paid 1.875 million reais upfront, with the remaining balance due in 24 monthly installments.

stories.title: Governo tentará antecipar conclusão da votação de PEC do fim da escala 6x1

en.title: Government will try to speed up conclusion of vote on PEC ending 6x1 work schedule
en.summary: Brazil's government leader in the Senate plans to request a special calendar for voting on a constitutional amendment that would eliminate the 6x1 work schedule. If approved, the amendment could be voted on in two rounds as early as the following week.

stories.title: Falhas em pagamentos internacionais custam milhões e afetam retenção de clientes, mostra pesquisa

en.title: Failures in international payments cost millions and affect customer retention, research shows
en.summary: A LexisNexis Risk Solutions study finds that international payment failures generate significant financial and operational costs. About 75% of financial and payment institutions estimate losing up to $5 million annually in customer revenue due to unsuccessful payments.
